excerpt.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
excerpt.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便虚境也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], even the Shroud feels oddly unsettled, as though its forces tremble in quiet apprehension.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长，还目睹了一个负面的灵能光环正在四处侵蚀。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse Psionic Aura. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 我们不知道是什么正在逼近，只知道它绝对会来。
texts.en: We do not know exactly what approaches, though we sense its coming with profound certainty.

label.zh: 我们必须做好最坏的准备。
label.en: We must prepare for the worst.
